## MechWarrior 1 Remake 1.1.2

Fixes.

- **The enemies on the two ice maps no longer stand still.** They were asleep until you came within about 650 m; they're awake from the start, and patrol or come for you.
- **In battles and defences the enemies come for you, as in MechWarrior (1989):** one whose own patrol can't bring it near now comes from any distance. A few still don't reach you: three were seen stopping a kilometre or more off (on the two ice maps and one other), and one that patrols far out.
- In a defence on one map (MW3's C3, third contract map) an enemy used to wait on a hilltop the whole mission. It comes down now.

Reach and attack contracts keep their maps' own patrols.

Saved games are unchanged: 1.1.2 reads and writes the same saves as 1.1.1.

You still need your own copies of MechWarrior (1989), MechWarrior 3 and Pirate's Moon.
